evidence.result: Partial: onsets 20 of 20 within 8.8 ms, 0 misses, 0 extras (pass). BPM 120.39 within 2, but 9 beats against a minimum of 10 (fail). Pitch: 3 of 5 tones within 10 cents; 220 Hz +15.6 c and 261.63 Hz +10.3 c fail. aubioonset and aubiotrack reruns byte-identical; aubiopitch not (2 hashes in 8 runs).
evidence.scope: Generated 120 BPM clicks and five sine tones, macOS arm64: onsets pass; beat count and two low-pitch tones fail; aubiopitch output not byte-stable across processes

summary: Audio event detection library and command-line tools for onsets, tempo and pitch. Produces analysis events from audio; useful when a lightweight onset detector is preferable to a broader analysis library.
use_when: Detect onsets or pitch from audio for timing experiments
Try a focused event detector alongside librosa
avoid_when: Need general spectral and music analysis: librosa
Encode or mux an audio track: FFmpeg

assessment.rationale: Official project describes onset, pitch and tempo analysis and GPLv3-or-later terms. Latest release and substantive activity dates not established.
